All verdicts are **Pangram 4**. This is not a detail. The Pangram API's
default model is **Pangram 3** (version 3.3.2), while the web dashboard runs
Pangram 4. On a 20-segment sample deliberately enriched for AI and Mixed, the
two agreed on **11/20** — the default called Human on 3 of 8 web-AI segments
and 5 of 6 web-Mixed, and never returned Mixed at all. Passing
`model: "pangram-4"` gave **20/20 exact agreement including all six
Mixed**.[^s-route]
proposed: All verdicts use **Pangram 4**. The Pangram API defaults to **Pangram 3** (version 3.3.2), while the web dashboard uses Pangram 4. In a 20-segment sample deliberately enriched for AI and Mixed verdicts, the default API and dashboard agreed on **11/20**: the default API labelled 3 of 8 dashboard-AI segments and 5 of 6 dashboard-Mixed segments Human, and it returned no Mixed verdicts. Passing `model: "pangram-4"` produced **20/20 exact agreement, including all six Mixed verdicts**.[^s-route]
rationale: The replacement removes the admonitory aside and identifies each route at every comparison point, making a consequential implementation distinction easier to follow while retaining all validation counts.
